candidates.name: Progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML)

candidates.protected_reason: This diagnosis may deserve minority protection because PML is a rare and often underdiagnosed condition, especially in patients with a history of immunosuppressive treatment.

candidates.protected_reason: This diagnosis may deserve minority protection because West Nile virus meningitis is a rare cause of meningitis, especially in areas with low incidence of the disease.
